ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are two current positions, the left side is labeled 2I, and the right side is labeled I; the outer dashed closed loop is labeled L4, and the arrow at its bottom points to the left, so viewed according to the direction in the figure, L4 is a clockwise loop, and it encloses both the left and right currents. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, the left-side 2I current flows out of the paper, and the right-side I current flows into the paper. For the clockwise integration path L4, according to the right-hand rule, its positive normal points into the paper, so current flowing into the paper is taken as positive, and current flowing out of the paper is taken as negative. The algebraic current enclosed by L4 is +I - 2I = -I. By Ampere's circuital law, \int_{L_4} \vec{H}\cdot d\vec{l} is equal to the enclosed algebraic current, so the result is -I.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify L4 as a clockwise loop enclosing both currents. Use the question text to assign magnitudes: left current is \(2I\) out of the page, right current is \(I\) into the page. For the clockwise L4 orientation, take into-the-page current as positive. Thus the enclosed signed current is \(+I-2I=-I\). Therefore \(\int_{L_4}\vec H\cdot d\vec l=-I\).

推理：根据题意，左侧 2I 电流流出纸面，右侧 I 电流流入纸面。对顺时针积分路径 L4，按右手定则，其正法向为指向纸内，所以流入纸面的电流取正，流出纸面的电流取负。L4 包围的代数电流为 +I - 2I = -I。由安培环路定律，\int_{L_4} \vec{H}\cdot d\vec{l} 等于包围的代数电流，因此结果为 -I。

method.method_draft: Trace L4 clockwise from the arrow in the figure. Around an out-of-page current, \(\vec H\) circulates counterclockwise, opposite to the L4 traversal, so the left \(2I\) contributes \(-2I\). Around an into-page current, \(\vec H\) circulates clockwise, the same as L4, so the right \(I\) contributes \(+I\). Superpose the two contributions: \(-2I+I=-I\). Hence \(\int_{L_4}\vec H\cdot d\vec l=-I\).
